query: AMD data center segment year over year growth most recent quarter

output.content: AMD’s most recently reported quarter is Q2 2026 (ended June 27, 2026), in which Data Center segment revenue was **$6.7 billion**, representing **107% year-over-year growth**; AMD attributed the increase to strong demand for EPYC processors and Instinct GPUs. [[1]]
